description:
Brand Introduction:
My Higher Being is more than just a brand—it’s a movement dedicated to promoting holistic wellness and the transformative power of mindful daily habits. Our mission is to inspire individuals to embrace practices that enhance their physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Through thoughtful designs and high-quality products, we aim to empower individuals to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

Product Descriptions:
Our thoughtfully curated merchandise includes collections like:

  • "I Wear My Habits" Collection: Apparel that celebrates the power of daily habits, including grounding, intermittent fasting, and meditation.
  • "I Sungaze" Collection: Inspired by the ancient practice of sun gazing, this collection promotes connection with natural energy.
  • "Red Lights After Sunset" Collection: Clothing designed to symbolize the importance of circadian-friendly lighting for better sleep and health.
  • Other Collections: Explore habit-focused apparel promoting hydration, self-love, and other positive lifestyle practices.

Each item is crafted to serve as a reminder and inspiration to embrace habits that elevate your higher being.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

  • Holistic Wellness Focus: Our merchandise is more than clothing; it’s a celebration of health-oriented, mindful living.
  • Empowering Daily Habits: Each design represents a habit proven to enhance well-being, making every piece meaningful and motivational.
  • Eco-Conscious Production: We prioritize sustainable, high-quality materials that align with our commitment to mindful living.
  • Inspiring Community: Affiliates are not just partners but ambassadors of a global wellness movement.

Payment Terms:
Affiliates earn a generous 15% commission for every product purchased through their referral. This transparent and rewarding structure ensures that your efforts are well-compensated while supporting a mission-driven brand.

Other Information:

  • Who Can Join? Content creators, influencers, bloggers, and wellness enthusiasts passionate about holistic living.
  • Marketing Tools: Affiliates will receive access to unique links, promo codes, and engaging promotional materials to make sharing easy and effective.
  • Support and Collaboration: Affiliates will have direct communication with the My Higher Being team for guidance, updates, and creative input.

By joining our affiliate program, you’re not just partnering with a brand—you’re becoming part of a movement that inspires people to embrace habits that transform lives. Let’s collaborate to create a healthier, happier world together!
